dream._note: DreamShaper 8 (SD 1.5, 768 px, the swatch is then 6.4 still px per art px). The SDXL base in the HF cache has only its configs, no weights, so it is not a variant.

target._note: tile 30 art px = one 60 px engine tile at 2x. swatch 200 = the 768 still seen as 200 art px (3.8 still px per art px; 120 lost the cracks). block 90 = the seamless material block, three tiles; corners and edge strips are cut from it and the centre is it darkened, so the texture is 150 art px = 300 screen px and NinePatch's 60 px margins give three-tile edge strips with no engine change. levels stretches the still's greys onto concrete0..concrete3 before the snap.
